contexts.text: Cassia and calamus () = natural truth, but that from which good comes.

Cassia () = interior truth from good. Cassia = the interior truth of the internal man... It is the inmost truth which is signified by cassia, for it is the fourth in order. The reason cassia = truth from good, is that inmost truth proceeds immediately from good, and acts conjointly with good in lower things; which takes place when the Intellectual acts entirely as one with the will... Illustrated.

Cassia is not mentioned elsewhere in the Word, but kesia is in , which is a species of cassia... The kesia here, which is a species of cassia = the Divine truth which proceeds immediately from Divine good, which truth is the inmost truth.
Inmost truth with its perception and affection is signified by cassia.
Kesia () = good of the third degree.
